statement: Let X be a smooth integral projective n-dimensional variety over an algebraically closed field, with n ≥ 2, and let L be ample. Put V = Ln, and choose an integer D ≥ 1 such that DL is very ample. There is a graded family of finite sets SN ⊂ Zn ≥0 such that SN ⊂ NP0, P0 = ∆(1/D, . . . , 1/D, Dn−1 V ), (3.1) #SN = h0 (X, NL) = V n! Nn + o(Nn ). (3.2) For every N, r ≥ 1 and m ≥ 0, if M(SN ) separates jets through order m at some r distinct torus points, then H0(X, NL) separates the same jets at some r distinct points of X.
